This Quarto notebook is the canonical executable source for
`scripts/compare_16s_v2_reproduction.qmd`. It compares the v2 reproduction of
the 12-sample analysis (same code, same executed parameters, rebuilt
environment, freshly downloaded reads) against the read-only copy of the
accepted v1 return, and writes a table of differences. It changes nothing in
either tree.

```sh
source config/16s_v2_paths.sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh scripts/compare_16s_v2_reproduction.qmd [v1_return_dir] [v2_derived_dir] [output_dir]
```

Automatic execution during rendering is disabled because this workflow writes
project outputs.

```{r}
#| label: compare-16s-v2-reproduction
#| echo: true
abort <- function(...) stop(sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
v2_inputs <- Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_V2_INPUTS")
v1_dir <- if (length(args) >= 1L) args[[1L]] else if (nzchar(v2_inputs)) file.path(v2_inputs, "v1_return_2026-09-03") else ""
v2_dir <- if (length(args) >= 2L) args[[2L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_DERIVED")
output_dir <- if (length(args) >= 3L) args[[3L]] else file.path(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_DERIVED"), "13_reproduction_comparison")
if (!nzchar(v1_dir) || !nzchar(v2_dir) || !nzchar(output_dir)) abort("Provide v1_return_dir, v2_derived_dir and output_dir.")
protected <- c("derived/16s_analysis", "derived/16s_manuscript_integration", "phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569", "OneDrive-nium.io")
for (p in protected) if (grepl(p, output_dir, fixed = TRUE)) abort("output_dir resolves into protected location %s", p)
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
read_tsv <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) abort("Missing %s", path)
  read.delim(path, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, quote = "", comment.char = "", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
write_tsv <- function(x, name) write.table(x, file.path(output_dir, name), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
read_fasta <- function(path) {
  x <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(path)
  setNames(as.character(x), names(x))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------ parameters
p1 <- read_tsv(file.path(v1_dir, "16s_dada2_parameters.tsv"))
p2 <- read_tsv(file.path(v2_dir, "03_dada2", "16s_dada2_parameters.tsv"))
params <- merge(p1, p2, by = "parameter", all = TRUE, suffixes = c("_v1", "_v2"))
params$identical <- params$value_v1 == params$value_v2
write_tsv(params, "16s_v2_reproduction_parameter_comparison.tsv")

# --------------------------------------------------------- read retention
r1 <- read_tsv(file.path(v1_dir, "16s_read_retention.tsv"))
r2 <- read_tsv(file.path(v2_dir, "03_dada2", "16s_read_retention.tsv"))
retention <- merge(r1, r2, by = "sample_title", suffixes = c("_v1", "_v2"))
retention$nonchimeric_difference <- retention$nonchimeric_pairs_v2 - retention$nonchimeric_pairs_v1
retention$nonchimeric_relative_difference <- round(retention$nonchimeric_difference / retention$nonchimeric_pairs_v1, 4)
write_tsv(retention, "16s_v2_reproduction_read_retention_comparison.tsv")

# ----------------------------------------------------------- ASV identity
s1 <- read_fasta(file.path(v1_dir, "16s_asv_representative_sequences.fasta"))
s2 <- read_fasta(file.path(v2_dir, "05_phyloseq", "16s_asv_representative_sequences.fasta"))
c1 <- read_tsv(file.path(v1_dir, "16s_asv_counts_unrarefied.tsv"))
c2 <- read_tsv(file.path(v2_dir, "05_phyloseq", "16s_asv_counts_unrarefied.tsv"))
m1 <- as.matrix(c1[, -1L]); rownames(m1) <- s1[c1[[1L]]]
m2 <- as.matrix(c2[, -1L]); rownames(m2) <- s2[c2[[1L]]]
m2 <- m2[, colnames(m1), drop = FALSE]
shared_seq <- intersect(rownames(m1), rownames(m2))
asv_summary <- data.frame(
  asvs_v1 = nrow(m1), asvs_v2 = nrow(m2), asvs_shared_by_sequence = length(shared_seq),
  reads_v1_in_shared = round(sum(m1[shared_seq, ]) / sum(m1), 4),
  reads_v2_in_shared = round(sum(m2[shared_seq, ]) / sum(m2), 4),
  total_reads_v1 = sum(m1), total_reads_v2 = sum(m2),
  count_matrix_identical = identical(m1[order(rownames(m1)), ], m2[order(rownames(m2)), ][rownames(m1)[order(rownames(m1))], , drop = FALSE]) && nrow(m1) == nrow(m2))
# Per-sample correlation of shared-ASV counts and Bray-Curtis between the two
# versions of the same sample.
per_sample <- do.call(rbind, lapply(colnames(m1), function(s) {
  a <- m1[shared_seq, s]; b <- m2[shared_seq, s]
  ra <- m1[, s] / sum(m1[, s]); rb <- m2[, s] / sum(m2[, s])
  all_seq <- union(rownames(m1), rownames(m2))
  ra_full <- setNames(numeric(length(all_seq)), all_seq); ra_full[names(ra)] <- ra
  rb_full <- setNames(numeric(length(all_seq)), all_seq); rb_full[names(rb)] <- rb
  data.frame(sample_title = s, reads_v1 = sum(m1[, s]), reads_v2 = sum(m2[, s]),
             spearman_shared_asvs = round(cor(a, b, method = "spearman"), 4),
             bray_curtis_v1_vs_v2 = round(sum(abs(ra_full - rb_full)) / 2, 4), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
write_tsv(asv_summary, "16s_v2_reproduction_asv_summary.tsv")
write_tsv(per_sample, "16s_v2_reproduction_per_sample_agreement.tsv")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- taxonomy
t1 <- read_tsv(file.path(v1_dir, "16s_asv_taxonomy_silva138.2.tsv"))
t2 <- read_tsv(file.path(v2_dir, "05_phyloseq", "16s_asv_taxonomy_silva138.2.tsv"))
rate <- function(t, rank) round(mean(!is.na(t[[rank]]) & t[[rank]] != ""), 4)
tax_rates <- data.frame(rank = c("Phylum", "Family", "Genus"),
                        assigned_fraction_v1 = sapply(c("Phylum", "Family", "Genus"), rate, t = t1),
                        assigned_fraction_v2 = sapply(c("Phylum", "Family", "Genus"), rate, t = t2))
# Concordance for ASVs shared by sequence.
t1$sequence <- s1[t1$asv_id]; t2$sequence <- s2[t2$asv_id]
tt <- merge(t1, t2, by = "sequence", suffixes = c("_v1", "_v2"))
for (rank in c("Phylum", "Family", "Genus")) {
  a <- tt[[paste0(rank, "_v1")]]; b <- tt[[paste0(rank, "_v2")]]
  a[is.na(a)] <- ""; b[is.na(b)] <- ""
  tax_rates[tax_rates$rank == rank, "shared_asv_concordance"] <- round(mean(a == b), 4)
}
write_tsv(tax_rates, "16s_v2_reproduction_taxonomy_comparison.tsv")

# ----------------------------------------------------------- alpha / beta
a1 <- read_tsv(file.path(v1_dir, "16s_alpha_diversity.tsv"))
a2 <- read_tsv(file.path(v2_dir, "06_ecology", "16s_alpha_diversity.tsv"))
alpha <- merge(a1, a2, by = "sample_title", suffixes = c("_v1", "_v2"))
write_tsv(alpha, "16s_v2_reproduction_alpha_comparison.tsv")
b1 <- read_tsv(file.path(v1_dir, "16s_beta_permanova.tsv"))
b2 <- read_tsv(file.path(v2_dir, "06_ecology", "16s_beta_permanova.tsv"))
key <- intersect(names(b1), c("metric", "term"))
beta <- merge(b1, b2, by = key, suffixes = c("_v1", "_v2"))
write_tsv(beta, "16s_v2_reproduction_permanova_r2_comparison.tsv")

print(params[!params$identical | is.na(params$identical), ])
print(asv_summary)
print(per_sample)
print(tax_rates)
```
